silhouette.reason: Bat wings, ringed swept-back horns, dorsal spikes and spade tail: reads as a dragon at once. The body is lumpy and potato-like and the legs short and stubby, so the outline reads cartoon rather than powerful.
fixes: smooth the muscle noise on the trunk (body.ts) so the outline follows big masses, not lumps
lengthen the legs ~15% and narrow the lower legs (legs.ts)

proportions.reason: 8.7 × 7.9 × 4.7 m: wings and head are in proportion, but the neck is short, the legs stubby and the tail thin compared with the body mass.
fixes: lengthen the neck chain by one vertebra (neck.ts)
thicken the tail root to match the hips (tail.ts)

materials.reason: Crimson vertex colour with cream belly plates and darker wing membrane; the surface noise reads as clay lumps rather than scales, all at one roughness; horns and teeth separate by hue only.
fixes: a scale pattern on the back and flanks (scales.ts stamps at LOD0)
roughness split: glossy eyes and teeth, rough membrane

detail.reason: Teeth, horns with rings, dorsal spikes, wing fingers, claws; no individual scales, membrane veins only painted, belly plates soft.
fixes: stamped scale rows on the neck and back
raised veins on the wing membranes

wear.reason: Pristine: no scars, no torn membrane, no chipped horns or soot.
fixes: a torn notch in one wing membrane and scars on the flank
chipped horn tips and soot around the jaw

lod.reason: LOD2 (4k) keeps the pose but the wings become flat triangles, the tail a thin stick and the body faceted.
fixes: keep the wing finger bones at LOD2 as thin quads so the wing outline holds
more rings on the LOD2 tail

technical.reason: QA PASS; 198.6k / 44.2k / 4.1k triangles, 6 draws. LOD0 is heavy for a game creature.
fixes: cap LOD0 near 120k by coarsening the hidden belly and inner-leg sculpt cells
